findings.description: Switching the match check from truthiness to `is not None` means an empty-string pattern is now compiled and accepted instead of rejected.
findings.rationale: With match="" and message=None, the old check `not message and not match` raised TypeError. The new check `match is None` is False, so the empty pattern is compiled. re.match("", s) succeeds for every string, so the predicate returns True for every exception and the retry policy silently retries all exceptions instead of failing fast at construction time.
